tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background. Brand black in dark (the default); soft white for printed and light documents.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and scorecards sitting on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, meter tracks, table header bands, inactive segments.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards and inputs.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The heavy scorecard rule under headers and above totals. Use at stroke-rule weight, never as a fill.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text. Brand white on black, brand black on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels. Brand gray on light grounds.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Icons, disabled borders and placeholder glyphs only. Fails 4.5:1 as body text: never use it for words.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill (result chips, toasts).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold as text and icons: ROUND in the wordmark, verified badges, earned levels, the active tab. Darkened in light theme so small text stays legible.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind gold text or a gold icon.

tokens.name: gold-mark
tokens.usage: Brand gold #E6B800 for shapes: the emblem, primary buttons, meters and rings, highlight bars.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill. Every primary button, the selected segment, the current step.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent. Always brand black (11:1 on gold).

tokens.name: corner-red
tokens.usage: The red corner. Only ever identifies the athlete assigned to it: scorecard columns, corner tags, bout cards. Never a state or an error.

tokens.name: corner-red-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind red-corner text.

tokens.name: corner-blue
tokens.usage: The blue corner. Same rule as corner-red. Also the focus ring colour.

tokens.name: corner-blue-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind blue-corner text.

tokens.name: cleared
tokens.usage: Medically cleared, eligible, complete. As text, legible on canvas, surface and cleared-soft.

tokens.name: cleared-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind cleared text.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Pending verification, expiring soon, needs a decision. Orange, kept clear of brand gold. As text, legible on canvas, surface and caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind caution text.

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: Suspended, not eligible, destructive. Darker and pinker than corner-red so the two never read as one; always paired with a word.

tokens.name: stop-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind stop text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in canvas, then 2px of this. Gold in dark, corner blue in light.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Montserrat Black and ExtraBold Italic, uppercase: the voice of the wordmark. Names, screen titles and the few words that should hit like a fight poster. Never for paragraphs.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover lines and the athlete name on a fighter page.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Screen titles on mobile, section openers in decks.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Montserrat SemiBold and Bold for interface text, Medium for running text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Verified by Coach Hassan Jizzini after Tuesday's session.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Results are written by the event's officials, not the athlete.
styles.usage: Helper text, list rows, table cells.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Montserrat with tabular figures: scores, records, IDs, dates. Digits always line up.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: The record on a fighter card.

spacing.note: 4px base. Screens breathe; scorecards and rosters stay dense.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges and dense table cells.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list; input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen top spacing, deck margins.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on large screens.

radius.note: Rounded but firm, like the app icon. Round only where the thing is round: avatars, corner dots, the emblem.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Meter segments, table chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, scorecards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars, corner dots, toggles.

shadow.note: Almost flat. Cards are separated by hairlines first, shadow second.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, the share card.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The gold edge glow from the app icon: the device frame, featured cards. One per screen at most.

stroke.note: Line weights, borrowed from a printed scorecard.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers, card borders, input borders.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Under table headers and above totals.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: The corner stripe on a bout card.
